description: The twenty-three film MCU arc from Tony Stark cave to the Snap and its reversal, told as one story about six stones and the people who would not leave them alone.
outcome: Thanos defeated; the Snap reversed; Stark and Romanoff dead

description: The Beyonder pulls a selection of heroes and villains to Battleworld and offers the winner anything they want; the heroes win by not playing.
outcome: Battleworld destroyed; heroes returned to Earth

description: A school explosion forces the Superhuman Registration Act; the hero community splits between Captain America refusal and Iron Man enforcement.
outcome: Registration enforced; Captain America surrendered and was assassinated later

description: Thanos assembles all six Infinity Gems and erases half the universe to court Death; the surviving heroes and cosmic entities counter-attack.
outcome: Gauntlet taken by Nebula, then by Adam Warlock; the Snap reversed

description: Jean Grey is corrupted by the Hellfire Club and the Phoenix Force, consumes a star and a planet, and the X-Men must decide whether to save or execute her.
outcome: Jean Grey sacrificed herself on the moon

description: A Sentinel-ruled future sends Kate Pryde mind back into her younger self to stop the assassination that started the war.
outcome: Assassination prevented; future timeline averted

description: Legion kills Xavier in the past, and the world he returns to is one where Apocalypse has ruled for twenty years and the X-Men were founded by Magneto.
outcome: Timeline restored; Apocalypse defeated in the altered present

description: Wanda Maximoff rewrites reality into a mutant-ruled world where her family is whole; the heroes who remember it have to ask her to stop.
outcome: Reality restored; mutants reduced to a few hundred

description: The Skrull Empire has been replacing heroes and officials for years; the invasion begins with a SHIELD helicarrier crashing into Central Park.
outcome: Skrull invasion defeated; Norman Osborn put in charge of national security

description: The Illuminati exile the Hulk to an uninhabited world; he lands on Sakaar instead and fights his way from gladiator to king.
outcome: Hulk crowned king of Sakaar, then returned to Earth for revenge

description: The Kree and Skrull empires bring their war to Earth, with the Avengers caught between SHIELD, the Inhumans and a pacifist Kree captain.
outcome: War averted on Earth by the Avengers and the Inhuman royal family

description: The Weapon X programme binds Wolverine to an operating table and coats his skeleton in Adamantium, erasing his memory and producing their perfect weapon.
outcome: Wolverine escaped; the programme continued

description: Norman Osborn is given control of national security after the Skrull invasion and rebuilds SHIELD as HAMMER with villains in every uniform.
outcome: Osborn regime collapsed at the Siege of Asgard

description: Osborn invades the floating Asgard over Oklahoma with HAMMER and a stolen Sentry, and the Avengers must defend a city that is also a god.
outcome: Osborn defeated; Asgard rebuilt; the Heroic Age began

description: An armour malfunction and a takeover of Stark International push Tony Stark into alcoholism, and the arc is about the armoured hero admitting he cannot fix himself.
outcome: Stark accepted he was an alcoholic and sought help

description: The Kingpin learns Daredevil identity and dismantles his life piece by piece — licence, home, mind — and Matt Murdock rebuilds from nothing.
outcome: Murdock rebuilt and defeated the Kingpin scheme

description: Thanos takes the stones across four fronts, and the Avengers lose every one of them. The film ends with the Snap.
outcome: Thanos won; half of all life erased

description: The surviving Avengers use the Quantum Realm to borrow the stones from the past, and the final battle is fought by everyone they brought back.
outcome: Snap reversed; Thanos killed; Stark and Romanoff dead

description: The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, and Zemo uses a HYDRA file to make the split about Bucky Barnes and Howard Stark instead of policy.
outcome: Avengers fractured; the Accords enforced; Zemo imprisoned

description: Hela takes Asgard, Thor is stranded on Sakaar, and the only way to stop her is to destroy the place he is trying to save.
outcome: Asgard destroyed; Hela dead; the Asgardians fled to Earth

description: Wanda Maximoff creates a sitcom reality around her grief in Westview, and SWORD, Agatha Harkness and the townspeople all try to end it.
outcome: The Hex collapsed; Wanda left as the Scarlet Witch

description: A Loki variant is arrested by the TVA and discovers the organisation maintaining a single sacred timeline, and the man who is actually running it.
outcome: The sacred timeline branched; Loki took a throne at the end of time

description: The MCU arc from the Hex to the Kang dynasty: every spell, portal and variant that opened the multiverse and the councils trying to police it.
outcome: Ongoing; the multiverse is unstable

description: The children of Thanos hit New York, Edinburgh and Wakanda in sequence to take the Time and Mind Stones.
outcome: Stones taken; the Order destroyed

description: The X-Men film continuity retells the Phoenix story as Jean Grey losing control of a cosmic force, with the team splitting over whether to save her.
outcome: Jean Grey killed and the school reopened

description: Four street-level heroes discover the Hand is digging under New York for a substance that will raise the dead, and that Elektra is leading it.
outcome: The Hand defeated; Midland Circle collapsed

description: The final incursion destroys the Marvel multiverse and Doctor Doom rebuilds what is left as Battleworld, ruling it as God-Emperor.
outcome: Multiverse restored; Reed Richards rebuilt reality

description: Original addition — a registration-style dispute between unaffiliated heroes and a metahuman authority, written for this demonstration as a small-scale civil-war analogue.
outcome: Negotiated settlement; the Vigil Accord formed

description: The Anti-Monitor destroys the multiverse one Earth at a time, and the surviving heroes fight a war across collapsing realities.
outcome: Multiverse collapsed into one Earth; the Flash and Supergirl died

description: Barry Allen saves his mother and creates a timeline where Atlantis and Themyscira are at war, Superman was never raised free and Bruce Wayne died instead of his father.
outcome: Timeline restored; the New 52 began

description: Bane wears Batman down over months and breaks his back, and Gotham is handed to Azrael until Bruce Wayne takes it back.
outcome: Batman recovered; Bane defeated; Azrael removed

description: Doomsday fights its way across America to Metropolis, and Superman dies stopping it. The funeral issues are the point of the story.
outcome: Doomsday killed; Superman resurrected months later

description: A retired Bruce Wayne puts the cowl back on at fifty-five, and the story is about whether Batman was ever anything but a necessary monster.
outcome: Batman faked his death and trained a new generation

description: The Joker shoots Barbara Gordon, kidnaps Jim Gordon and tries to prove that one bad day is all it takes to make anyone into him.
outcome: Barbara paralysed; the argument left unresolved

description: Jason Todd goes looking for his mother and finds the Joker instead; the readers voted for the ending.
outcome: Jason Todd killed; the Joker escaped

description: A year-long murder mystery in which a Holiday killer takes one victim a month and the answer turns out to be the district attorney.
outcome: Two-Face created; the Falcone family broken

description: An old friend orchestrates a year of attacks on Batman using every villain in Gotham, and the case ends with Catwoman and Batman closer than ever.
outcome: Hush defeated; the Riddler revealed as the architect

description: Ra al Ghul steals Batman contingency plans for every Justice League member and uses them one by one, which is worse than beating them.
outcome: League freed; Batman expelled from the team

description: The Black Lantern rings raise the dead across the universe and every Corps has to fight its own casualties.
outcome: Black Lanterns defeated; the White Lantern entity appeared

description: Sinestro builds a fear-powered Corps on Qward and attacks Oa, and the Guardians respond by rewriting their own laws.
outcome: Sinestro captured; the Guardians authorised lethal force

description: Alexander Luthor and Superboy-Prime pull Earth-Two back into existence and try to rebuild a single perfect Earth out of the survivors.
outcome: Multiverse restored; Superboy-Prime imprisoned

description: Darkseid and the Anti-Monitor fight a war across the multiverse with the Justice League as instruments, and Batman ends up sitting in a Mobius Chair.
outcome: Anti-Monitor defeated; Darkseid killed; Batman briefly omniscient

description: A future in which the Justice League has retired and a new generation of heroes has started killing; the old guard returns to stop the war.
outcome: Nuclear detonation; the League rebuilt the world afterwards

description: An earthquake levels Gotham, the government abandons it and the city becomes a year-long territory war run by its own villains.
outcome: Gotham rebuilt; Batman returned to the city

description: Terra is a mole inside the Teen Titans working for Deathstroke, and the team is picked apart from the inside.
outcome: Terra killed; Deathstroke defeated; the team rebuilt

description: Amanda Waller builds a squad of convicts with explosive collars and sends them on the missions the Justice League would refuse to authorise.
outcome: Programme continued despite the body count

description: A villain coalition organised against the Justice League itself, and the first time the League had to fight an enemy that planned like they did.
outcome: League broke the coalition; several members imprisoned

description: Steppenwolf collects the three Mother Boxes on Earth, and the newly formed League has to stop him before Apokolips has a bridge.
outcome: Steppenwolf killed; the Mother Boxes separated

description: Zod terraforms Earth into Krypton above Metropolis, and Superman has to destroy his own species to stop it.
outcome: Zod killed; Metropolis levelled; Superman revealed

description: Amanda Waller sends Task Force X into a city taken over by Enchantress to recover a high-value asset, and loses two members doing it.
outcome: Enchantress defeated; the Squad honoured unofficially

mission_name: The War for the Throne of Atlantis
description: Orm declares war on the surface and Arthur Curry has to win a trident and a duel to stop him.
outcome: Orm deposed; Arthur crowned; the war called off

description: Malcolm Merlyn plans to level the Glades with a seismic device, and Oliver Queen has to stop it with a bow and a small team.
outcome: Device partially detonated; the Glades destroyed

description: Team Flash fights a speedster god who turns out to be a future version of Barry Allen, and the only way to win is to let him erase himself.
outcome: Savitar erased; Iris survived

mission_name: Vandal Savage and the Time Masters
description: Rip Hunter assembles the Legends to stop Vandal Savage from rewriting history, and discovers the Time Masters were never on their side.
outcome: Savage defeated; the Time Masters dissolved

description: Clark Kent grows up in Smallville hiding what he is while kryptonite-powered threats and Lex Luthor friendship collapse around him.
outcome: Clark accepted the cape; Lex became the enemy

description: Original addition — a disaster-relief pact between unaffiliated heroes and two Lantern sectors, written for this demonstration as a small-scale coordination exercise.
outcome: Accord signed; the Blue Lantern Circle formed

description: The MCU council of Kangs begins moving between branches after the sacred timeline ends, and the Avengers franchise is rebuilt around stopping them.
outcome: Ongoing; the multiverse is unmanaged

description: SHIELD replaces the town of Pleasant Hill with a prison for supervillains whose minds have been rewritten, and the heroes find out from the inside.
outcome: Pleasant Hill exposed; trust in SHIELD broken again

description: A murder with a Justice League weapon turns the League, Justice League Dark and the Justice League of America against each other.
outcome: The factions fractured; the Crime Syndicate followed

description: The Crime Syndicate of Earth-3 replaces the Justice League and the villains of Earth have to save it, which is the joke and the point.
outcome: Crime Syndicate defeated; the League restored
